column1: # tests/memfn/c12_ceilings.tsv -- C12, THE EMITTED-FORM RATCHET's CEILINGS
# (integration.md §9.3 I5, §10.5, §R4.3.4; born at R4c, lane r4cchecks,
# 2026-10-06, from TODAY'S tree on lane/memfn-r4c).
# C12 counts, per (emitter file, vocabulary line, libc call name), the search
# FORMS that file's emitters SPELL in emitted text (string literals; the
# emitter's own comments excluded; tests/memfn/search_vocab.tsv names the
# shapes, tests/memfn/c17_lex.py reads the literals). Each row is a CEILING
# that only DESCENDS:
#   - more forms than the ceiling is red: a replaced form came back as a
#     second spelling (D122), or a new one was spelled outside the kit;
#   - FEWER than the ceiling is red too ("lower the ceiling"): a migration
#     step's REPLACE commit lowers its rows in the same commit, and a stale
#     high ceiling would be room for a form to return unseen. It also makes a
#     lexer or vocabulary that stopped seeing forms red, never green;
#   - a form with NO row here has ceiling 0.
# The number on a row is the ONE literal a REPLACE commit edits: M1's REPLACE
# lowered the emit_dfa.c memchr row 8 -> 2 (R4c, lane r4cfix: pcrec_emit_find
# and emit_attempt stay until M2/M4; the six M1 spellings are the kit's);
# M1b's REPLACE deleted src/gen/runcmp.c's three rows (memcmp 1, runcmp-bytes
# 2, runcmp-words 4: the run compare is the kit's, memfn/src/runcmp.c);
# M2's REPLACE (R4g) lowered the emit_dfa.c memchr row 2 -> 1 and deleted its
# walk-fmt row (1 -> 0): pcrec_emit_find's two forms are the kit's
# (memfn/src/pffind.c);
# M3's REPLACE (R4h) deleted the emit_dfa.c walk-open row (2 -> 0) and its
# walk-stmt row (2 -> 0): the STAY skips and the scan edge's two loops are
# the kit's ADVANCE (memfn/src/generic.c, stmt_advance); emit_vm.c's
# walk-open row stays at 1, the strided span loop (vm_stride_loop, VMSTRIDE,
# M6), the stride-1 loop being the kit's (VMSPAN);
# M4's REPLACE deleted the emit_dfa.c memchr row (1 -> 0): emit_attempt's
# `(?m)^` skip is the kit's (MLINE, memfn/src/pffind.c's pf_memchr_back), so
# no memchr( is spelled outside the kit (the ratchet's end, integration.md
# M6's REPLACE (R-10) deleted the emit_vm.c walk-open row (1 -> 0): the
# strided span loop is the kit's (VMSTRIDE); the same commit added the
# emit_vm.c span-count row at 1, NOT a raise of an existing form's count
# but a form the vocabulary had never seen (the cursor rung's lazy rmin
# prefix, VMLAZY, listed `pending` by RULING Q-R10-7, main 2026-10-08).
# A RAISE is never routine: it needs a ruling, named in the commit.
# D147 add. 12 (N6 retired: vm_rev_emit's backward walk is a mirrored one-position VM step, not a search site) deleted the emit_vm.c walk-back row (1 -> 0) and its vocabulary line.
# R-12's NORMALIZE (lane vmlazy, abi 70 -> 72) re-spelled the lazy prefix as a
# capped span scan in the kit's ADVANCE layout: the SAME site's form changed
# shape, so its row swapped span-count 1 -> walk-open 1 (the total stays 2;
# not a raise: M6's swap is the precedent). The span-count vocabulary line
# stays at ceiling 0 as the tripwire for the old counted loop (Q-R12-6).
# R-12's REPLACE (lane vmlazy) deleted that emit_vm.c walk-open row (1 -> 0):
# the lazy prefix is the kit's VMSPAN/VMSTRIDE site, so emit_vm.c spells no
# search form and the only row left is enc_utf8.c's span-decode (N7U).
# R-12's VALID listing (Q-R12-5, lane vmlazy) added enc_utf8.c's swar-hibit
# row at 1: NOT a raise of an existing form but a form the vocabulary had
# never seen (`$_valid_upto`'s ASCII SWAR skip, pending VALID), by RULING.

# The row count (2) and the total (2 forms; 1 before R-12's VALID listing, 2 before R-12's REPLACE; R-12's NORMALIZE swap: span-count 1 out, walk-open 1 in; 3 before D147 add. 12's walk-back deletion; M6's swap: walk-open 1 out, span-count 1 in; 7 before M7, whose REPLACE deleted the encoding seam's two span-index rows (enc_byte.c 3, enc_utf8.c 1); 8 before M4, 12 before M3, 14 before M2 (the header read 13, stale), 20 before M1b, 26 before M1) are echoed by the check; the
# independent control is the vocabulary's own reach (rule 4 of C17).
# Columns (tab-separated): path, vocab line-id, libc call name (libc-call
# lines only, else -), ceiling, note.
